reviews.x: The tube that the product was supposed to be in had a condom in it instead of the actual product.... I returned it within two hours of receiving it. I’m beyond disgusted.

I really didn’t feel like waiting to order from the official drunk elephant website because prime would get it to me sooner. I am disgusted at the fact that the seal was open and it has a strange separate barcode over the one on the original package. I don’t know if I’m getting what I paid for so I will not be using it. Disgusted. Looks like others who purchased the same product had the same experience.

reviews.t: Great Product, but price point hard to swallow. Excellent for winter skin though.
reviews.x: My skin loves this. I've been using oils for skin care before it became a huge trend ( Clarins). Wayne Goss talked about this brand, and I'm a skin care specialist so I HAD to try it. It IS excellent, but Holy Moly it costs EVEN MORE than Clarins... But my skin loved it. I just can't afford it, because I have little ones who grow so fast.

A friend recommended this the Drunk Elephant NightBright duo to me, so I ordered this travel size as a trial.  It worked so great, my face feels baby soft and is no longer dry.  Also, the marula oil is a grail product of skin care.  I swear the stuff made my brows and lashes thicker.  Any way, with all the positive results, I recommended to my friends and they are loving it as well!

I bought from this seller as I saw on the Drunk Elephant website that Quiverr was the only authorised seller of their products on Amazon. The marula oil is gorgeous, sinks right into your skin without a greasy feeling. I use the AHA/BHA once a week, it exfoliates well without stinging or over drying. Recommend this for anyone wanting to try DE products before splashing out on the full size.

reviews.t: For the price and only liking one of two, not worth it.
reviews.x: Im 26 with oily acne prone skin..I've heard great things about drunk elephant and I was excited to try this. I bought this duo with the travel size juju and peeke bars. The marula oil definitely isnt my favorite, even with just using the slightest amount my skin feels really oily like it's just sitting on my skin and not absorbing. I do love the night serum tho, the texture of my skin has improved a little bit and I've only had this duo since Saturday. To pay $28 dollar and only like one product

reviews.t: Love it. It hasn't caused me to break out ...
reviews.x: This stuff makes my skin SO soft! Love it. It hasn't caused me to break out or anything (I have very sensitive/sensitized skin, so I was worried).

I love this drunk elephant duo. I have noticed a difference in my skin and it confirmed it the other day when my friend stopped in the middle of our conversation to say my complexion looks good. It made my day actually haha but yes I will continue using these products. I might keep buying the trial sizes because I heard you get more for your money that way. I highly recommend this duo!!!

reviews.t: Pay attention to the size of these tiny bottles. ...
reviews.x: Pay attention to the size of these tiny bottles. They are actually the size of a sample you would get at a Sephora or a Department store when they want you to try a product and there wasn't much in the tiny bottles. It was defiantly not worth the money. I can't say much about the product because there wasn't much to try!

Good stuff but only got two uses from pink bottle before it ran out.  Update: Customer service is very responsive and sent a new set right away.  Meanwhile, the one that seemed empty suddenly started working so, since the product is such a great one, I paid for the replacement, apologized to the supplier and am retracting my premature bad review.
I really, really like these products. I have rosacea and if you think breakout are bad in your teens and twenties, consider being nearly 80 and having them! My skin is much improved.

reviews.t: The size and price of these little guys is great for traveling and carrying in your purse
reviews.x: The size and price of these little guys is great for traveling and carrying in your purse. The luxury face oil is great though didn't notice any dramatic changes or improvements. Found it good for hands and cuticles though. The Night Serum though...yikes. The morning after one use my skin was bright and happy. I tried it the next night and woke up to inflamed and angry cheeks and a chin full of red bumps. I saw my dermatologist who could not prove (or deny) that the serum was to blame but glycol

This is amazing! If this is your first time trying this product, please order this FIRST before fully committing to it. There's nothing wrong with the product or anything but it's just a tip since these products are expensive.  I ended up buying the full size products because I loved them so much. When I put on the night cream, I don't put anything else on because the oil is also hydrating too. It can be expensive, but I do like this product so far!
I use this nightly . The travel size lasts me 2 months used daily

reviews.t: Perfect size to test product - in LOVE with the Glycolic Night Serum
reviews.x: HIGH RECOMMEND: I really wanted to try DE, but was turned off by the high price tags, then i came across their sample sizes and thought, now is the time to try them without my wallet feeling it.  -Nighttime Skincare Routine with T.L.C. Framboos Glycolic Night Serum is EVERYTHING. I repeat EVERYTHING, it has truly helped the redness in my skin go down. Although there is a slight tingle, this is normal for the product as noted on DE's own website. The size has also lasted me about 3 weeks and i am

reviews.t: Love the way my skin feels
reviews.x: I've actually been using the products for about 2 months and I love the way my skin feels and how its improved. I'll continue to use it for as long as I can afford it and for as long it works for my skin. It's a bit pricey for the larger sizes but it works. The Marula Oil works great as a moisturizer. It's also made to allow the TLC to work better so it's a must have from the DE lune.

reviews.t: Price too high - too little benefit
reviews.x: I've been using these just over a week and some change and I see no difference in what I normally use ... the price for this product is way too high and these are TRAVEL sizes, not the regular - the normal size pricing seems a bit extreme as do these ... I just don't see any difference and will not be ordering again , really not worth the price

reviews.t: We were disappointed but maybe it works best for folks that have ...
reviews.x: I ordered this for my daughter after reading a review that it worked well for acne. It did seem to help for a couple of weeks and then when her skin flared again it did not help at all. We were disappointed but maybe it works best for folks that have only occasional flare ups? Not sure!

Been hearing about this product a long time and now l am so glad l finally brought it. My skin loves it l have very sensitive skin and this did not affected it. After one week l can truly feel and see the difference. So soft. It is a bit pricey but a little goes a long way.

reviews.t: This cleared up my skin and keeps me from getting ...
reviews.x: This cleared up my skin and keeps me from getting pimples. And yes people they are small! its called a sample!
There was no products in the package, only an empty cylinder case that was missing the cap

reviews.t: It does works but not sure if it is worth the price...
reviews.x: I purchased both the nighttime and daytime samples. Overall great products but the price is a little steep in my opinion. The Pixi brand has a great alternative glycolic serum, vitamin c serum, and oil blend for much cheaper and works just as well. I did however really enjoy the B-hydra serum and am considering purchasing again. The vitamin c serum had a weird smell though that was off-putting but did slowly fade acne scars over time.

reviews.t: Saw a difference within a few days
reviews.x: I have very pretty sensitive skin, especially once the fall hits in New England and starts stripping the moisture from my skin. I couldn't believe that I not only saw a difference in reduced congestion, more hydration, and overall clearer skin within a few days, but that my skin didn't react to it! I liked being able to get a travel size to try this out. Time will tell how much more my skin can clear up.

Really like the Drunk Elephant line for sensitive skin. Duo travel sizes great for traveling or smaller sizes to try product before committing to full size. I use the TKC Framboos almost nightly with my Drunk Elephant moisturizer and the Virgin Marula Oil a few times a week. Will maybe use more frequently during these winter months

Love love love the night time serum. The marula oil does not clog pores. My face feels and looks wonderful in the morning. If you want to try it go this route. Lasts a reasonable amount of time.... I would say go full size with absolute confidence you won't be disappointed you spent a few extra bucks

claims.text: Many reviewers love the products and report softer, clearer, or improved skin, with several saying they would repurchase or buy full size.
Several reviewers find the products expensive or not worth the price, especially given the small travel/sample sizes.
Some reviewers report packaging and authenticity problems, including an open seal, a replaced barcode, and a wrong item in the tube.
A few reviewers note the marula oil felt too oily or greasy on their skin.
Some reviewers praise the travel size as a good way to try the products before committing to full size.
